text: Hello! It's the weekend. No school today! It's Sunday, November 15. Time for the weather! Sunday. A slow and cosy sort of day. Here in Shanghai, the day will be drizzly. The high will be 19 degrees, and the low will be 13 degrees. It should feel pleasantly mild. Rain is about 16 percent likely today. There are 39 days to go until a special day. Can you guess which one? Take your raincoat with you. Splashing is allowed! Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be under a blanket of cloud, reaching 18 degrees. Here's a question: if you had a boat, where would you sail to? That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
